Devlop Marina

Modernize your Marina management with an integrated, 100% digital solution.
Ready to take the next step?

Contact us

What is Devlop Marina?

Devlop Marina is a digital solution designed to fully digitize and integrate marina management and all interactions with users, vessels, owners, clients, and service providers.

It is aimed at nautical entities looking for a robust platform to centralize processes, improve operational efficiency, and ensure compliance with authorities.

Ideal for marinas, both public and private, that seek efficiency, security, and centralized information management.

Operational Management

Reservations and Mooring Posts

- Reservation and management of Mooring Posts (MPs).
- Definition of berth locations and vessel classes.
- Contracts for the sale or temporary assignment of MPs.

Vessel and Crew Registration

- Complete registration of legal information for vessels, owners, skippers, and crew.
- History of vessel modifications.
- Automatic communication with customs authorities.

Vessel Check-In and Check-Out

- Automatic generation of check-in forms.
- Logging of vessel occupancy and departure.
- Control of vessels with outstanding debts.

Commercial Space Contracts

- Management of rental contracts for commercial spaces.
- Scheduling of renewals and deadline alerts.
- Integration with billing and financial systems.

Service and Shipyard Management

Services Provided
-Management of services (daily, weekly, monthly) and locations (on water, in shipyard, in storage).
– Pricing by vessel class and seasonal rates.

Shipyard Management
-Definition of streets and berths.
– Management of docked vessels.
– Scheduling of technical services.

Transform your Marina Management!

With Devlop Marina, gain more control, greater efficiency, and better results. Contact us for a personalized demo.

Contact us now!

Financial Management and Accounting

Billing and Customer Accounts
– Management of client accounts.
– Issuance of payment letters and balance tracking.
– Logging of non-operational expenses and income (Cash Area).

Commissions, Withholdings, and Invoicing
– Management of beach sales commissions.
– Issuance of tax withholding reports (IRS/IRC).
– Automatic invoicing of services rendered.
– Integration with accounting systems for billing management.
– Electronic invoicing compliant with legal requirements and digital integration.

Key Features

Integrated management of mooring post reservations and contracts

Complete registration of vessels and crew

Automatic communication with customs authorities

Management of services and seasonal pricing

Shipyard management with scheduling and service logs

Financial control: collections, balances, late payment interest

Cash area for managing additional income and expenses

Management of sales commissions and tax withholdings

Automatic invoicing and accounting integration

Statistics and reports on occupancy, sales, and services

Contract management with document integration and electronic signature

Management of commercial space contracts (shops, services, etc.)

Who is it for?

  • Marinas and Recreational Ports
  • Municipal Managers of Nautical Infrastructure
  • Private Nautical Tourism Entities
  • Charter Companies or Vessel Service Providers

Main Benefits

100% integrated operation

Reduced administrative workload

Automated legal compliance

Digital access on any device
